record_type_quote: We conducted a close replication of the seminal work by Marcus and colleagues from 1999, which showed that after a brief auditory exposure phase, 7‐month‐old infants were able to learn and generalize a rule to novel syllables not previously present in the exposure phase.

targets.authors: Marcus, G. F., Vijayan, S., Bandi Rao, S., & Vishton, P. M.
targets.title: Rule learning by seven‐month‐old infants.
targets.evidence_quote: We conducted a close replication of the seminal work by Marcus and colleagues from 1999, which showed that after a brief auditory exposure phase, 7‐month‐old infants were able to learn and generalize a rule to novel syllables not previously present in the exposure phase.
targets.outcome_quote: Our results did not replicate the original findings: infants showed no difference in looking time between test patterns consistent or inconsistent with the familiarization pattern they were exposed to.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The abstract and discussion explicitly report failure to replicate. The methods identify the matched original as Experiment 2. Four laboratories jointly retest one original paper; other extensions and previous failures are background.

reasoning: Title and author list verified against complete primary article. Completed multicenter data collection and analyses, not the Stage 1 protocol. One original paper.
